SELECT 
  so.id,
  so.client_id,
  so.service_id,
  so.price_cop,
  so.price_usd,
  so.custom_description,
  c.name as client_name,
  c.email as client_email,
  s.display_name as service_name,
  s.description as service_description
FROM service_orders so
JOIN clients c ON so.client_id = c.id
JOIN services s ON so.service_id = s.id
WHERE so.id = '{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.serviceOrderId }}'
  AND so.payment_status = 'pending'

UPDATE service_orders
SET 
  mercadopago_preference_id = '{{ $('Create Preference (Service)').item.json.id }}',
  payment_link = '{{ $('Create Preference (Service)').item.json.init_point }}',
  payment_link_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '72 hours'
WHERE id = '{{ $('Get Service Order (Create)').item.json[0].id }}'
RETURNING id

SELECT 
  id,
  mercadopago_preference_id,
  payment_status,
  payment_link,
  cancelled_at
FROM token_transactions
WHERE id = '{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.transactionId }}'
  AND payment_status = 'pending'
  AND cancelled_at IS NULL

SELECT 
  id,
  mercadopago_preference_id,
  payment_status,
  cancelled_at
FROM service_orders
WHERE id = '{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.serviceOrderId }}'
  AND payment_status = 'pending'
  AND cancelled_at IS NULL

UPDATE token_transactions
  SET payment_link = '{{ $json.init_point }}'
  WHERE id = '{{ $('Get Token Transaction (Retry)').item.json.id }}'
  RETURNING id

UPDATE service_orders
SET payment_link = '{{ $('Get Service Preference').item.json.init_point }}'
WHERE id = '{{ $('Get Service Order (Retry)').item.json.id }}'
RETURNING id
